_comment: Shared work queue for the solaris-android autoloop. Single source of truth between Planner/Builder/Verify. Labels are mirrored FROM this file, never the reverse.

queue.theme: Solaris design pass — app UI theme + energy widgets
queue.scope: #15: app-wide Solaris dark theme (bg #070709/#0c0c0e, accent ServiceBay blue #3b82f6/#2563eb), filled/rounded button styles, typo; restyle activity_home + activity_pairing (Solaris brand/logo, tiered cards, nicer 'connected' status) + activity_widget_config; device-picker row layout with type-icon+name+room instead of simple_list_item_1. #16 builds ON #15: three energy widgets in the Solaris card look — (1) 'Jetzt' 2x2 flow-grid PV/Haus/Netz/Akku with colored W + direction (redesign EnergyWidgetProvider), (2) 'Verlauf' multi-line chart PV/Haus/Netz/Akku + 24h/7d toggle persisted per instance via /napi/portal/entity-history (upgrade EnergyStatsWidgetProvider), (3) 'Gesamt' 2x2 kWh totals grid from /napi/portal/energy totals (new provider). colors.xml currently holds only the Google template — real palette must be added.
queue.acceptance: colors.xml + a Solaris AppCompat theme applied app-wide (dark bg + blue accent + button styles); home/pairing/config screens restyled to Solaris look; device picker uses a custom row (icon+name+room); the three energy widgets render in the dark card style with correct colors/directions and the Verlauf widget has a working 24h/7d per-instance toggle. Compiles; Robolectric green. Visual correctness confirmed on-device (verify gate).
queue.notes: Priority. #16 depends visually on #15 — build #15 first within the cluster. Data endpoints exist (solarisbay#762 CLOSED). entity_ids for the multi-line chart come from /napi/portal/energy flow — no new server ticket needed.

queue.theme: App icon — ServiceBay blue adaptive background
queue.scope: Replace the Google-template adaptive icon (currently white background + ic_maskable, transparent foreground). Set ic_launcher_background = solid ServiceBay blue #3b82f6 (optional #2563eb gradient/edge); ic_launcher_foreground = the Solaris mark (cut-out/white). Re-render mipmap-*/ic_launcher.png legacy densities with the blue background. No white/black icon field.
queue.acceptance: Adaptive icon shows blue #3b82f6 background with the Solaris foreground; legacy PNGs regenerated; no white/black flat field. Compiles.
queue.notes: Small. Foreground can reuse the existing ic_maskable mark tinted/cut-out over blue.

queue.theme: Crash-reporter UX — staged dialog + GitHub-issue report
queue.scope: Rework the DISPLAY only (capture to filesDir/last_crash.txt stays). Stage 1: friendly message ('Es ist ein Fehler aufgetreten. Bitte melde ihn...') with [Details] / [Fehler melden] / [Schließen]. Stage 2: [Details] reveals the scrollable stacktrace + [Kopieren] (as today). [Fehler melden] opens a prefilled GitHub issue via Custom Tab: github.com/mdopp/solaris-android/issues/new?title=<Crash: ExceptionClass>&body=<urlencoded trace + app version + Build.MODEL/Build.VERSION.RELEASE>, trace truncated to ~8KB URL limit. Include app version + device/Android version in the report body.
queue.acceptance: Crash surface shows the friendly Stage-1 dialog first; Details reveals the trace + Copy; 'Fehler melden' opens a prefilled new-issue URL carrying the (truncated) trace + app/device metadata. Compiles; Robolectric green.
queue.notes: showTrace currently dumps the full trace immediately with only Copy/Close. No login/token needed for the GitHub prefill URL.

device_test.what_to_check: Universelles Geraete-Widget mit Live-Daten: platzieren, ein HA-Geraet konfigurieren, schalten/oeffnen (Garage/Tuer mit Confirm-403). Daten ueber /napi/ (solarisbay#762 CLOSED).
Energie-Widget size-adaptive: klein = Netz in/out, gross = PV/Haus/Netz/Akku-Fluss. Live-Daten via /napi/portal/energy.
Energie-Statistik-Widget: 48h-Hausverbrauch-Sparkline via /napi/portal/entity-history. Rendert mit echten Daten.

upstream_waits.reason: Voice widget: on-device capture (RECORD_AUDIO -> RecognizerIntent) is buildable, but the user-facing flow is blocked on the web-chat ?ask=<text> auto-submit URL schema. #766 must define/ship the exact URL (e.g. /#/?ask=…) before the app fixes its Custom Tab target. Build the capture scaffold ready; wire the URL when #766 closes.

completed.note: Closed by planner. Widget polish delivered (type icons + state color, gradient/border card bg, previewLayout placeholders, per-leg magnitude bars). Further energy-look refinement folded into #16.

release_warnings: SEAL BASE: batch/design-pass is stacked on feat/standalone-widgets-app (PR #12), NOT origin/main (still the retired TWA). The batch PR must target feat/standalone-widgets-app, not main — everything stays stacked until PR #12 lands on main as the standalone app.

notes.note: #11 = multi-tenant CONCEPT/umbrella epic (largely executed by the standalone refactor in PR #12). Tracking-only — NOT queued as buildable.
#3 = Play Console upload — human-gated release work, cannot run headlessly. Not queued; leave open as human task.
Latest build v2.7.0 (versionCode 15) on feat/standalone-widgets-app (PR #12). solarisbay#762 (widget /napi/ endpoints) CLOSED — widget data is live.
